kids.name: c3
kids.chars: freeze is keyed to the server's private link to Bybit (24 §10.1 "WS disconnect (freeze)"; B5–B7 WS_DISCONNECT; E33-Q04 scenario 5 "sever the private execution stream") and algos keep running when this window goes away (US-ALGO-006 NFR; 13 §9) vs copy keyed to "the backend": "algo pauses if the backend disconnects" (SCR-066 checklist), "algos pause if backend down" (SCR-070 mock), "backend reconnecting" (SCR-070 States), "Given the backend websocket disconnects … algos are suspended while the backend reconnects" (E33-S06 AC), and E17-D01's SCR-152 body for a lost connection to this window (merged, #3905): "… Exchange-side stops still protect open positions; app-managed rules are paused."; server death (20 §11.1 row F7) has no copy; OCO's residual risk is keyed to the app being offline (SCR-069 Type and checklist; E33-S05; E33-D03 "Residual risk is explicit"; US-ALGO-002 "Given the app is offline when the target fills"), when the server still settles the legs; the freeze arm exists only on B5 working, B6 armed and B7 working, so under the root's "onUnhandled": "defer" a loss of Bybit while an iceberg waits to refill or cools down is held until its next slice has been sent (a reading of the contract)

kids.chars: one paused for "user pause, WS disconnect (freeze), or rate budget exhausted" (24 §10.1) with three rules: user → RESUME; budget → "automatic when tokens return" (E33-T01); freeze → unstated ("resume, reconciled"); B7 paused + RESUME → working with no reconcile vs US-ALGO-007 "chasing resumes only after the adopted state is confirmed"; 23 §6.4 sends no context_summary for B4–B7; E33-T02's AlgoRun has halt_reason only; only B7 has a RATE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED arm (B5, B6 none, against E33-T01's framework rule), and B4 and B6 price_blocked take no USER_PAUSE; B6 paused takes only RESUME and USER_CANCEL, so a DURATION_END while paused is deferred and, after Resume, can send the rest at market through final_sweep (a reading of B6.3); US-ALGO-006 recalculates the time left on resume "with the option to extend or compress", which no TwapParams field holds

kids.chars: Freeze vs the account dead-man's switch

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: the run's freeze keeps orders working (24 §10.1) vs the account going "down" after 30 s, "dead-man's switch called" (20 §7.2 CV_ACCOUNT_DOWN_S) or "the dead-man's-switch policy is invoked" (US-ACCT-010), whose policy "(cancel working orders, flatten, or notify only) executes as soon as connectivity returns" (US-RULE-013); threshold "configurable 10–120 s" (US-RULE-013 NFR) vs "≤ 30" (20 §7.2)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: C-2.6 "Every position-opening order … must carry a native exchange-side stop-loss" and 30 §7.2 E32 "the OMS refuses to acknowledge any position-opening order that does not carry a native exchange-side SL" vs 24 §8.8 rule 2 "If an entry must be placed without an attached SL (e.g. an algo child that would over-attach), the OMS places the position-level SL … immediately on the first fill, within a 2 s deadline"; 14 §12.3 "Native-SL invariant" omits SCR-066–068; a reading (24 gives no reason): in full TP/SL mode (24 §8.1's default tpsl_mode) an attached stop is the whole position's (R02 §2.2 "Entire Position"; 24 §8.5: "In Full mode a position has one exchange-side stop"), and 24 §8.8 rule 6 records every stop the OMS requests, an entry's attached one included, as the position's stop, so each slice, refill or replace would rewrite it and could loosen a stop the user tightened (24 §8.8 rules 5 and 6; B1 notes); E32-T01 (#931) allow-lists algo_child_over_attach for PASS_DEFERRED (a trading-stop write with a 2 s deadline, its pending_native_sl row written before the adapter call), and E32-K01 (#856) restructures such children "rather than accepting a trading-stop window" if the trading-stop path's p99 exceeds 1.5 s

kids.chars: State words and the kill switch

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: (1) AlgoState pending … failed (24 §10.1) vs CMP-118 error vs SCR-066 configured, "auto-paused on disconnect" vs SCR-070 degraded vs 13 §9 PENDING/ARMED/PARTIAL vs B4–B7 ids (price_blocked, bound_exceeded, parked, overshoot); (2) kill switch: B4–B7 root KILL → failed vs "halted by risk control" (epic E33 AC4; US-ALGO-005/006; E33-T01; E33-S06; 10 §5 scenario 10); (3) "explicit re-arm" has no E33-T02 verb (pause, resume, cancel, cancel_and_flatten); (4) "arm" already names E30's one-click arm, B4/B7 arming and B6 armed; (5) FREEZE is the kill switch's typed word (SCR-072); the E33 threat model (Draft) settles (2) and (3) for E33-T01: a terminal halted with halt_reason, distinct from failed (CX-10, SR-E33-19; its §11.3 note 3 amends 24 §10.1), "re-arm" meaning a new run or a resume that passes SR-E33-02, and an authority_revoked halt when the creator loses access (§4.1; E33-X02 case 4)

kids.chars: 22 AlgoSpec vs 24 §10, the parameter owner (each §10.x says so): iceberg jitter 0 vs 0.2 (E33-S02 "jitter is on by default"); TWAP jitter 0 vs time 0.25 / size 0.20; TWAP duration ≥10 s vs SCR-066 ≥1 min; slices ≤500 (SCR-066; 22; E33-S03 Security notes "bounded by slices ≤ 500", and its 500-slice perf schedule) vs max_children 450 (24 §10.1; E33-T01); chase repricings 20 vs 200; interval 250 ms (min 50) vs 200 ms (floor, E33-S04); distance "from the arrival price" (SCR-068) vs "from the arm price" (24) vs max_slippage_ticks (22); no 22 field for on_disconnect, OCO mode, chase timeout and peg, TWAP catch-up, participation, price limit, window end; 450 slices in SCR-066's 1 min minimum is a 133 ms interval vs E33-S03 oms.algo.twap.min_slice_interval_ms=1000; no lower bound on iceberg visible size against max_slices 450 (24 §10.3), where E33-T01's child cap ends a run "completed" with quantity left

kids.chars: What OCO is for; the double fill

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: (1) use: US-ALGO-002 "hitting a target cancels the stop and vice versa" and SCR-069's standalone OCO on a position vs 24 §10.2 "for the plain 'TP + SL on a position' case, use Bybit's native attached TP/SL" and E33-S01 "is refused"; (2) speed: "within 1 second" (US-ALGO-002) vs "<=300 ms … to opposing-leg cancel request" (SCR-069) vs cancel_timeout_ms 2000 (22); (3) double fill: automatic reduce-only market for the excess + warning (24 §10.2; B4 overshoot) vs "P1-severity incident … one-click 'flatten to intended net position'" (13 §9; M-028) vs "Critical", blocking modal (17 §6); (4) on a fill: reduce_other (24 default) vs "the stop is cancelled" (US-ALGO-002)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: (1) SCR-070 "Algo state arrives on orders, coalesced to 2 Hz" and E33-T02's algo_run record vs 23 §6.2 "orders and executions are never throttled or coalesced"; (2) CMP-118 progress "sourced from the client-side … local state machine" vs US-ALGO-010 NFR "server state, not client memory"; (3) CMP-118 has no oco and no flatten; (4) CMP-123 calls Bybit cancel-all directly, and 22 cancel-all "Protects TP/SL exits" by skipping reduce-only orders (protective OCO legs are reduce-only); (5) "last reconciled" (E33-D03, E33-S06) has no AlgoRun field; (6) E33-T02's /algos paths vs 24 §19.2, which maps doc 14's /algos to /orders with an algo block; (7) "pause all" (SCR-070, E33-S06) has no endpoint (E33-T02 has POST /algos/cancel-all only) and E33-S06 forbids looping per row; (8) no field carries a restart time or downtime (23 §15.9 has only a planned shutdown_notice)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: viewer controls "absent rather than disabled-with-tooltip" (E33-D03; E33-S06 "controls absent") vs "disabled with a reason tooltip, not hidden" (14 §0.5 item 5), P3 "present-but-disabled with an explanatory tooltip ('Read-only role')" (10 §4), "Disabled controls always say why" (16 §1); adopt "owner/manager-only" (E33-D03; E33-S06) vs RSK-077 "adoption under management Owner-only, step-up, re-running the validator and attaching a stop or refusing"; untracked orders: B1 consumes CANCEL and AMEND there and audits them, and ADOPT passes only adoption_allowed, which "denies every adoption until E45-S01 records the Owner's decision D6" (B1.5 adoption_allowed; INV-B1-l; E29's D6, which the E33 threat model's D7 extends); RSK-077's trigger includes an untracked row "cancelled by a rule, algo or group cancel"; E29-D01 D2 draws both disabled; a key revoke names the algos it would orphan (10 §5 scenario 9); E33-D05: "a viewer's monitor row names must not include controls they lack"

kids.chars: "every emulated algorithm is stopped" (US-RULE-014) vs 22 setKillSwitch and KillSwitchResult, silent on algos; cancel_open_orders default true (22; 24 §8.11) vs SCR-072 checkboxes "both default off"; 30 §7.2 E39 "stops new risk, does not force-close"; maintenance: SCR-148 Type "algos paused" vs its A11y line "Running algos are cancelled" and 22 "cancels only running emulated algos" (open follow-up #3380); the E33 threat model (Draft) settles that every blocking source, maintenance included, halts runs (CX-09, SR-E33-06; algo.halted, its §8.1)

kids.chars: Which rate model governs algo traffic

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: 24 §8.7: per-UID endpoint classes (order.amend 10/s; normal soft-throttled at 80 %; reserve_fraction 0.10 + 2 tokens) vs 20 §4.3: a per-account AccountRateBudget, critical 40 % ("default 4 req/s of 10": SL attachment, reduce-only closes, cancel-all / kill-switch), entry 40 % ("New entries and fan-out children, amends"), poll 20 %, which E34-T02 (#859) implements "verbatim" vs C-12.7: a reserve "(default 30%) for risk-critical actions (stop placement, cancel, flatten)"; RSK-078: "the reserve value is written three ways"; GET /me/limits reports per account orders_per_minute_limit, orders_per_minute_used and rate_budget_pct_used, not per-class headroom; for algo children the E29 threat model's SR-E29-01 (its clause from E33-X01) and the E33 threat model (Draft; CX-08, SR-E33-08) put a child's create or amend in entry whatever its reduce_only, never in the reserve, and a halt's cancels in critical, so OCO's settle amend draws entry; no text names its settle cancel (a single cancel has no 20 §4.3 bucket)

kids.chars: Closing a position while algos run

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: cancel_on_position_flat=True on every AlgoSpec and "running --> cancelled: user cancel / position flat / max_duration exceeded" (24 §10.1) vs a POSITION_FLAT arm only on B4 racing and B5 working, none on B6, B7 or any paused state (a flatten while paused is deferred, a reading); the paths that close: CMP-123 (Bybit cancel-all + a market close per position), SCR-063 close (Ctrl+W, which 05 §3.3 item 4 blocklists, and Ctrl+Shift+W; E29-D01 AM-2 proposes Ctrl+Delete for both), E29-D01 D7 Flatten account (Ctrl+Shift+F), a lockout's flatten (10 §3 scenario 4); SCR-063's "Close 25%" and "Close 50%" leave the position open; after CMP-123's Bybit cancel-all an iceberg goes waiting_refill, defers the POSITION_FLAT and sends one more slice before it cancels (a reading of B5.3); "cancel and flatten" (SCR-066 checklist) "additionally submits a reduce-only close" (E33-T02) of no stated quantity; a lockout's flatten can reach B5 as POSITION_FLAT before its halt, ending the run "cancelled" (a reading of B5)
